name: beyond_add_document
description: Add a shared markdown-style project document to TB_DOCUMENT. DOC_ID is generated as doc_{random}. ACTOR_TYPE is always AI, and actor_name must identify the LLM model name and version.

file_name.description: Document file name, such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md, business_requirements.md, or test_scenario.md.

doc_content.description: Full markdown document content to store.

actor_name.description: LLM model name and version, such as GPT-5 Codex 2026-08-12 or the exact MCP client model identifier.

include_json_content.description: When false, omit duplicated JSON from text content and rely on structuredContent.
